description: Claude Code plugins by Bitken Technologies

plugins.name: shipsmooth
plugins.description: A workflow for agentic coding where 1) you track implementation plans and tasks in version control, issue tracker 2) identify and implement the risky/unknown bits first 3) implement vertical slices of functionality 4) only increase code quality and test coverage after sufficient de-risking

plugins.name: shipsmooth-beta
plugins.description: [BETA] Rust CLI preview of shipsmooth, the same workflow on a single ~2 MB native binary (no JRE). Separate plugin with its own /shipsmooth-beta:start command; can be installed alongside shipsmooth. POSIX only (Linux x64, macOS x64/arm64). Expect rough edges.
